help.title: How StockMind works
help.subtitle: A quick tour. You can reopen this any time from Settings.

steps.warehousesBody: Create a warehouse, then divide it into sections. Inside a section you can build a tree of pallets, shelves and bins that mirrors the real floor.
steps.productsBody: Add a product once, then receive and dispatch against it. Record a cost price to see stock value, or a unit weight to count a pile by weighing it.
steps.batchesBody: Receive under a lot code with an expiry date. On dispatch, FEFO automatically sends the soonest-to-expire stock out first.
steps.offlineBody: Everything is stored encrypted on this device, so the app keeps working in airplane mode. Reminders still ring on time.

outbox.title: Pending actions
outbox.subtitle: Saved on this device. Nothing here is in stock until the server confirms it.
outbox.empty: Nothing waiting. Every action was confirmed by the server.

reason.auth: Waits until you sign in again.
reason.insufficient-stock: Not enough stock when it was sent.
reason.no-access: You have no access to this warehouse.
reason.too-old: Saved more than 7 days ago. Check it before sending.
reason.history-changed: The server's current history no longer contains this confirmed action (database restored?).
reason.history-mismatch: The server's record for this action does not match what was sent.
reason.access-revoked: Your access changed. Check this action, then send it again or discard it.

outbox.maybeRecorded: May already be recorded. It is resolved with the same request, never doubled.
outbox.unknownOutcome: Access was removed before the result was known. Ask your manager to check the stock history.
outbox.discardBody: It will not be sent. Stock does not change.
outbox.queued: Saved on this device. It is sent when the connection is back, and is not in stock until confirmed.
outbox.needsReview: This action needs your review in Pending actions.
outbox.signOutBody: {{count}} actions are saved on this device. They stay here and are sent the next time {{email}} signs in.
outbox.resetNotice: The server rebuilt its stock history. Figures were reloaded from scratch.
outbox.signOutBody_one: 1 action is saved on this device. It stays here and is sent the next time {{email}} signs in.

receipt.rechecking: Confirmed earlier · re-checking against the server
receipt.unverifiable: Confirmed earlier · could not be re-checked ({{reason}})
receipt.lastKnown: Last receipt: confirmed {{time}} as movement {{movement}}, revision {{revision}}.

unverifiable.receipt-without-movement: the server has a record but no movement

outbox.sending: Sending… the server is slow to answer. It stays saved on this device and is never applied twice.

state.READY: Replacement saved on this device · not sent yet
state.UNKNOWN: Replacement sent · the answer was lost. Open the review to check it.

replaced.done: Replaced · the server recorded a new movement for it
replaced.provenance: Original action {{original}} was missing from the server history. Replaced by movement {{replacement}}.

risk.duplicate-risk: Duplicate risk · the server now holds BOTH the original and its replacement. Tell your manager; do not change stock yourself.
risk.replacement-missing: History changed again · the replacement is no longer in the server history. Open the review.

reviewFlow.title: Review a lost action
reviewFlow.whatHappened: The server's history changed (for example, the database was restored). This action was confirmed earlier, but the server's current history no longer contains it. That does not prove it never happened, and it was NOT sent again.
reviewFlow.receiptNote: This is what the server told this device earlier. It is not current stock.
reviewFlow.stockNote: From the last sync. The receipt above is never added to this figure.
reviewFlow.stockNone: No synced figure for this product yet.

status.absent: Not in the server's current history.
status.present: The original is in the server's current history.
status.indeterminate: The server cannot say for sure.
status.unavailable: It belongs to a warehouse you no longer have access to.

failure.offline: No answer from the server. Replacing needs a connection and a fresh check. Nothing was changed.
failure.denied: The server refused the check (sign in again, or you lost access).
failure.server: The server failed to answer. Try again in a moment.
failure.unsupported: This server cannot check history generations, so replacement is not offered.

why.not-lost: This action is not waiting for a replacement decision.
why.no-receipt: There is no receipt to identify the original, so it cannot be replaced from here.
why.attempt-in-progress: A replacement for this action is already on its way.
why.check-stale: The check is too old. Check again before deciding.
why.original-present: The original is back in the server history. No replacement is needed; stock already includes it.
why.indeterminate: The server holds a partial record. Do NOT replace it. Ask your manager or the operator to look at the history.
why.unavailable: You no longer have access to that warehouse. Ask your manager.

reviewFlow.replaceWarning: Replacing creates a NEW movement ({{sign}}{{qty}}) with its own request, recorded with a note that names the original. If the loss was intended (for example a deliberate rollback), do NOT replace. If you are unsure, ask your manager first.
reviewFlow.confirmBody:
{{kind}} {{sign}}{{qty}} · {{product}} · {{warehouse}}

The server will check again and record a new movement only if the original is still missing. This cannot be undone from the app.
reviewFlow.retryNote: It uses the same request as before, so the server applies it at most once.
reviewFlow.sendingNote: Sending… the server may be slow. It stays saved on this device and is never applied twice.
reviewFlow.unknownNote: The answer was lost, so the server may or may not have recorded it. Tap Retry: it is the same request and cannot be applied twice.
reviewFlow.readyNote: Saved on this device and not sent yet.
reviewFlow.doneBody: The server recorded a new movement for this action. Stock follows the server figures.

blocked.stale-generation: The server's history changed while you were reviewing. Nothing was recorded. Check again.
blocked.original-present: The original is in the server history. Nothing was recorded and none is needed.
blocked.original-indeterminate: The server holds a partial record of the original. Nothing was recorded. Ask your manager or the operator.
blocked.original-unavailable: The original is in a warehouse you no longer have access to. Nothing was recorded.
blocked.insufficient-stock: Not enough stock to dispatch this now. Nothing was recorded.
blocked.in-progress: The server has not finished an earlier request. Nothing was recorded. Try again later.
blocked.no-access: You no longer have access to this warehouse. Nothing was recorded.
blocked.invalid: The server refused the request. Nothing was recorded.
blocked.key-reused: The request conflicts with an earlier one. Nothing was recorded.

risk.duplicate-risk: Duplicate risk: the server holds both the original and the replacement. Tell your manager. Do not change stock yourself.
risk.replacement-missing: The replacement is no longer in the server history. Check again; you may need to decide again.

reviewFlow.acknowledgeNote: Dismissing only removes this reminder on this device. Stock does not change.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Who has access to the company
team.openHint: Manage who can use the company's data
team.loadError: Could not load the team. Check the connection and try again.

status.suspendedHint: Cannot sign in. You can reactivate them at any time.
status.removedHint: Removed from the team. Their history is kept.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.body: Their access ends immediately; nothing they send afterwards is recorded. You can reactivate them later.

remove.title: Remove {{name}} from the team?
remove.body: Their access ends immediately and their warehouse permissions are cleared. Their past activity stays on record.

revoke_sessions.title: Sign {{name}} out everywhere?
revoke_sessions.body: Every device will have to sign in again. The account itself stays active.

changeRole.title: Change role for {{name}}
changeRole.body: Current role: {{role}}. It applies from their next request.

ack.title: Access to every warehouse
ack.body: {{name}} will become {{role}}, which sees every warehouse of the company. Are you sure?

done.suspend: {{name}} is suspended. Their access has ended.
done.reactivate: {{name}} is active again. They will need to sign in.

error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
error.OWNER_REQUIRED: Only the company owner can do that for an Admin.
error.LAST_OWNER: This is the last active owner of the company; they cannot be suspended or removed.
error.CANNOT_MODIFY_SELF: You cannot change your own access.
error.INVALID_TRANSITION: That is not possible for the member's current state.
error.NO_CHANGE: The member already has that role.
error.ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_REQUIRED: Please confirm that this role gives access to every warehouse.
error.ACTOR_NOT_ACTIVE: Your own access changed. Please sign in again.
error.TARGET_NOT_ACTIVE: Reactivate the member first, then change their role.

team.accessRevokedLogin: This account is suspended or was removed from the company. Contact your administrator.
team.accessNotice: Your access to the company changed, so you were signed out. Actions waiting on this device are kept and will not be sent on their own; you will review them when you return.

access.title: Warehouse access
access.loadError: Could not load this member's access. Try again.
access.allWarehouses: Admins and managers see every warehouse, so there is nothing to assign here.
access.noMoney: Prices and costs are not part of any choice here; they have a separate permission.
access.saved: Saved. It applies from the member's next request.

effect.transfer: Transfers between warehouses he has access to

noneAssigned.title: No warehouse is available to you yet
noneAssigned.body: Ask an administrator to give you access to a warehouse and it will appear here.

cp4.title: Who gets access to the new warehouse?
cp4.hint: Default: nobody. Managers and administrators see it automatically.
cp4.guidance: The new warehouse will be visible to managers and administrators only. Ask an administrator to give staff access to it.

error.conflict: Someone changed this member's access since you opened it. It was reloaded; review it and save again.
error.notEnforced: That choice has no effect on this server right now, so it was not saved.
error.exceeds: You cannot grant more than you hold.
error.notApplicable: This member already sees every warehouse.
error.notPermitted: You are not allowed to manage team access. Nothing was changed.
error.inactive: This member is not active. Reactivate them first.
error.self: You cannot change your own access.
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
error.notFound: That member or warehouse was not found.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
